August 7, 1941.

Mrs. Liselotte MERGLER

Mrs. Liselotte Mergler, nee Schumitzki,
German Jewess, was born at Koenigsberg, Germany,
on September 16th, 1921. She arrived in Shanghai
on June 27th, 1939 and is in possession of a German
passport J.II/12754/38.

Her father, Alfred Scharnitzki, is the owner
of the Hermes Stamp Co., 605 Bubbling Well Road.

Mrs. Mergler was married to Harry Mergler,
Austrian, in January or February 1941, the ceremony
taking place according to Chinese Law. Harry
Mergler is understood to be a motor mechanic.

Mrs. Liselotte Mergler speaks fluent English,
Italian, French, Danish and German. She is at
present residing with her husband at 51/12 Route de
Grouchy.
pages.zh:
1941年8月7日。

利塞洛特·梅尔格勒夫人

利塞洛特·梅尔格勒夫人（娘家姓舒米茨基），德籍犹太女子，1921年9月16日出生于德国柯尼斯堡。她于1939年6月27日抵达上海，持有德国护照 J.II/12754/38。

其父阿尔弗雷德·沙尔尼茨基是静安寺路605号赫尔墨斯邮票公司（Hermes Stamp Co.）的业主。

梅尔格勒夫人于1941年1月或2月与奥地利人哈里·梅尔格勒结婚，婚礼依中国法律举行。据悉，哈里·梅尔格勒是一名汽车机械师。

利塞洛特·梅尔格勒夫人能流利使用英语、意大利语、法语、丹麦语和德语。目前她与丈夫居住在格罗西路51/12号。

CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
1026

S.1. Special Branch...........Status. File No.................... Date...August 7, 1941.

SUBJECT: Mrs. Liselotte MERGLER

Mrs. Liselotte Mergler, nee Scharnitzki,
German Jewess, was born at Koenigsberg, Germany,
on September 16th, 1921. She arrived in Shanghai
on June 27th, 1939 and is in possession of a German
passport J.II/12754/38.

Her father, Alfred Scharnitzki, is the owner
of the Hermes Stamp Co., 685 Bubbling Well Road.

Mrs. Mergler was married to Harry Mergler,
Austrian, in January or February 1941, the ceremony
taking place according to Chinese Law. Harry
Mergler is understood to be a motor mechanic.

Mrs. Liselotte Mergler speaks fluent English,
Italian, French, Danish and German. She is at
present residing with her husband at 51/12 Route de
Grouchy.

by 7/8.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE AUG 8 1941 SPECIAL BRANCH）

A. C. (Special Branch)

J. E. Cornwell
D. S. I.
